Offline map engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's Offline Maps rollout covers storefront language. Xcode, system frameworks, and Connect actually separate in-app offline map download from product-page copy:

  • Apple Maps Offline Maps & region download — Apple Maps feature that lets users Download Offline Maps and save offline map areas for use without cellular data on supported iPhone and iPad models. Controls in-device download behavior — not App Store language.
  • MapKit offline tile packs & region caches — frameworks some apps use to prefetch map tiles, store offline regions, or serve maps when the device is offline. Your listing may mention Download Offline Maps or offline map areas; building tile caches and offline routing pipelines is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Offline region picker & download progress UI — separate in-app surfaces where buyers select a city or region, confirm download size, and browse saved offline map areas. Listing copy explains those buyer benefits; offline storage wiring is outside AppLocale scope.
  • Location permissions & cellular data settings — NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription and offline map storage when saving large region packs. Entitlements and download wiring are platform work — distinct from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains Offline Maps to buyers.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of offline map support in the binary.

A working offline map download story and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

US/EU indie teams often merge four Maps string families. This page covers product-page listing copy that markets Apple Maps Offline Maps — download offline map areas and browse maps without cellular data — not turn-by-turn directions hub copy, not street-level Look Around preview, and not item tracking:

  • Offline Maps & download marketing (this page) — paragraphs and frame text explaining "Offline Maps", "Download Offline Maps", "Apple Maps Offline", "Offline Map Areas", "Save maps offline", "Download a region", Ultra Offline Maps, 离线地图, 下载离线地图, 离线地图区域, and 保存离线地图. Select region → download → browse offline without cellular.
  • MapKit directions listing copy (different) — in-app maps, turn lists, nearby places, route previews: Maps, Directions, Nearby, 地图, 导航, 附近. Directions and discovery hub — not offline tile download as the hero. Covered on our MapKit guide.
  • Look Around listing copy (different) — street-level immersive preview on map marketing frames. Look Around is a preview surface — not offline map pack download marketing. MapKit page may mention Look Around on secondary frames; this page does not lead with it.
  • Find My listing copy (different) — item and AirTag tracking with Find My network and Lost Mode: Find My, AirTag, 查找. Item locate — not offline map areas. Covered on our Find My guide.

Offline Maps adds region download and offline browsing without cellular data. MapKit directions adds turn-by-turn and nearby discovery. Look Around adds street-level preview. Find My adds item tracking. Mixing vocabulary across those surfaces on one product page reads like confused localization — scope each screenshot frame to the workflow it actually shows.
